UPDATE 2026-11-14 (first slice, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; split out and closed as PROG-E6A): pure gesture model in lib/builder/gesture.ts (long-press state machine, drop hit-test, reorder, Alt+Arrow keyboard twin) and a layer list on /pages/canvas with press-and-hold drag, keyboard and Up/Down button reorder. No real-device touch test has been run; the order is local, not saved. Still open: spacing handles, canvas drag, the nested layer tree, presets-first inserter on the canvas, wiring to a real document, and the phone gate.

2026-11-16 (SCAN-1207): evidence refresh. The 2026-10-05 line says no editor drag-drop exists; re-test the premise against components/page-editor before working this row. Parked until 2027-01-05.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (PROG-E6B, direct manipulation on the real document, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS): on the Space page draft that PROG-E5B wired to /pages/canvas, a move in the layer list is now saved; the layer list is a nested tree (rows, columns, blocks) with a keyboard and button path to every place on the page; the selected block has spacing handles that walk the document's named steps (space above, padding, space below) and can store nothing else; and blocks are added presets first, blank second. All of it rides the one draft write action and its revision guard. No migration. The canvas frame, which stayed empty in a real browser, now draws. Pictures of the real components on a fixture document are in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6b/. Of the list in the 2026-11-14 note, four are closed (spacing handles, the nested layer tree, the presets-first inserter on the canvas, wiring to a real document). Still open on this row: (1) drag across columns and rows, and drag on the canvas itself (today a drag reorders inside one column; across is Up, Down or the keyboard); (2) the frame draws only the selected block as plain words, so handles are not yet on a true render of the page; (3) rows and columns: add, remove, reorder, change the column count from the canvas; (4) remove, duplicate and hide a block from the canvas, and undo; (5) the live data sections (About, Offerings, Events) in the inserter, which needs the Space page builder's lock rule; (6) the keyboard model beyond moves (a roving focus through the tree, shortcuts); (7) the same controls in the website and Space builder shells; (8) the phone gate: the full authoring path on a real phone has not been run, and no save has been made from a browser against a database.
